'''Defensive domes''' were large structures used to protect the [[Senatorial Palace/Legends|Senatorial Palace]] and other buildings or [[City/Legends|cities]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] from extreme temperatures. They had portals to let [[Starship/Legends|starships]] land or depart.<ref name="Bombad">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi|d=y}}</ref>
